One line per NBA game played: date, tip time, teams, final score, winner and overtime periods. It lists completed games only, not future schedules. Regular season, play-in, NBA Cup final and playoffs are in one file, told apart by season_type; preseason and the All-Star game are left out.
:::

## Columns

One row per game played. 15 columns. A row is identified by `game_id`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>season</td><td>string</td><td>Season the game belongs to, written like 2025-26.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>Part of the season: regular_season, play_in, cup_final (the in-season NBA Cup championship game) or playoffs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_id</td><td>string</td><td>League game id, ten digits starting with 00; keep it as text so the leading digits survive.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Date of the game in U.S. Eastern time, as the league lists it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>tip_time_et</td><td>string</td><td>Scheduled tip-off in U.S. Eastern time, 24-hour HH:MM; populated for games since February 2021 and blank before.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the home team; at a neutral site, the team the league designates as home.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_team_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the home team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_team_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the home team at the time of the game.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the away team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_team_id</td><td>string</td><td>League id of the away team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_team_name</td><td>string</td><td>Full name of the away team at the time of the game.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_pts</td><td>int</td><td>Final score of the home team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_pts</td><td>int</td><td>Final score of the away team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>winner</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the winning team; blank only for a game that was still in progress when the file was built.</td></tr>
<tr><td>ot_periods</td><td>int</td><td>Number of overtime periods played (0 for a game decided in regulation); blank in the rare game whose recorded minutes do not add up.</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
```

## Source and method

Compiled by Slam Dunk Bets from the NBA's official game statistics and daily scoreboards. Games appear once they have been played.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the NBA files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every NBA file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season, play-in, Cup final and playoff game, from the official box scores and play-by-play. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
